title: Frazier's parade drums and present snare, bass drum and cymbal
summary: He recalls the duplex snare shared with Alfred Williams, describes his current Leedy snare, Slingerland bass drum, price paid in 1947 and Zildjian cymbal.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Early drum kits and the gear drummers used

blocks.x: You say you used to play these parades. You use the same drum as you've got here now?

Well, not this snare drum. I had another black. They both live. I had a black wood shell drum, similar to one like Happy Youth. And lots of parades in the later years, I used to use the same drum on his trapania used. Used to call it duplex snare drum. Oh, duplex. Me and Alfred used to alternate with the duplex snare drum, you see. We alternate on parades. If I go play a parade, he wouldn't be working with it. I get the snare drum from him.
Is that the one Alfred Williams got now, or is that a different one?
Well, I don't know. I don't know. It's the same duplex snare drum. I think it's the same drum on his trapania. I believe it's the same drum.
What drum you got there now?
This is a leader. Oh, leader, yeah. A leader snare here. Wood shell.
Yeah.
Metal hoop shell. That's a five bar. That's a six bar, a fourteen.
Yeah. It's got metal hoops and a wood shell.
Wood shell. Metal hoops, yeah.
How about the bass drum you have there? What's that? Slingland is it?
That's a Slingland bass, yeah.
And what about the cymbals?
I got this snare drum around 1947, like something like that. I love this drum here for a while.
Groomwald music still.
Yeah. Can you remember how much it cost in them days?
I just bought this drum separate. I paid 32 and a half for it. 32 and a half dollars. Yeah, 32 dollars. I bought it separate.
When was that, you said?
Around 47 or 46 something like that. 1947.
What cymbal do you use?
That's Zildjian.
Yeah, Zildjian.
Genuine cymbal. That cymbal is over 20 years old.
Yeah?
I have that cymbal over 20 years old.
It's got a pretty nice tone to it.
Genuine cymbal.
You want to do a little soft beating on that one, Andrew?
Yeah, that's a pretty nice tone.
That's 14. It's 14 and similar.
It's got a nice tone to it.
Yeah.
